question: How Does Preordering Work?
answer: Choose PRO or GOLD. Your initial payment counts toward the device price. Manufacturing takes 4 months. After the readiness notice, pay the balance within 10 calendar days; a reminder gives 5 more days. Shipping, taxes and duties are extra. For voluntary cancellation, refund of the initial payment: 100 % if you cancel before production starts, 50 % after production has started.

question: What Comes with My UNO?
answer: Your set includes UNO, an illuminated reservoir, one battery, a charger, a reusable self-fill capsule, a hose, mouthpiece and connector, cleaning brushes and tweezers, a spare ceramic bowl, five spare membrane valves, instructions and branded packaging. PRO has a carbon mouthpiece, black hose and tinted reservoir; GOLD has a titanium mouthpiece, white-braided hose and transparent reservoir. Available separately, by agreement when ordering: extra battery; Pro capsule with four zones; separate charger; bowl; hose, mouthpiece and connector set.

question: When Will My UNO Ship?
answer: Manufacturing takes 4 months from your initial payment; this is not door-to-door delivery time. We notify you when your UNO is complete and inspected. Shipment follows receipt of the final payment. The route, shipping cost and expected delivery date for your country are confirmed individually before dispatch. Payment is not offered for India (IN), Thailand (TH), Turkey (TR) or Qatar (QA). We will contact you about delivery options

question: How Can I Track My Order?
answer: After your initial payment, you receive an order confirmation and order number by email. We email you when your UNO is ready. After your final payment, we ship your order and email your tracking number. Your personal account is coming soon. Basic operation starts from the device screen without a phone.
